newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Settler beats Palestinian boy, father says.
newsitem.headline: Settler beats Palestinian boy, father says.

text.p: A 10-year-old Palestinian boy was in critical condition in a Jerusalem hospital on Sunday after being beaten by a Jewish settler who suspected him of throwing rocks at Israeli cars, his father said.

Police said Hilmi Shosa collapsed while being chased by the security chief of a Jewish settlement near the West Bank town of Bethlehem and there were no external signs on his body that he had been beaten.
The security official was arrested and police said they had begun an investigation.

"One of the security people...beat him. Even if he threw rocks, you shouldn't do this to a little boy. He has internal bleeding in his head. The doctors told me his chances are zero," Hilmi's father Sair told Israel Television.

"Can there be peace when things like this happen? If you want peace, you have to get rid of all the fanatics -- from both sides," said the father, interviewed at his son's bedside in the intensive care ward of Jerusalem's Hadassah hospital.
